A '''featured article''' should be an article that we want all to see. Featured articles will rotate weekly.
<br />They will also:
#&hellip;be well-written and detailed.
#&hellip;follow the [[Help:Style guide|Style Guide]], and all other [[:Category:Policies|policies on A Wheel of Time wiki]].
#&hellip;be unbiased, view [[Wotwiki:OOC|Out of Character vs. In Character knowledge]] for more info.
#&hellip;be sourced with all available sources and appearances.
#&hellip;not be tagged with any sort of improvement tags (i.e. more sources, expand, etc).
#&hellip;have no more than five redlinks and none in the introduction, infobox, or any templates.
#&hellip;have significant information from all sources and appearances, especially a biography for character articles.
#&hellip;be completely referenced for all available material and sources.
#&hellip;have all quotes and images sourced.
#&hellip;include an "Appearance" and "Activities" section on all character articles.
#&hellip;include a reasonable number of images of sufficient quality to illustrate the article, if said images are available.
#&hellip;be at least 2.500 bytes in size.

== Suggestions ==
Suggest other articles which could be featured here, or suggestions for removal/replacement of current featured articles by contacting [[User:Moridin 2000|Moridin 2000]].
